arxiv-2004-06413.title: On the Possibility of Having Roman Pots around IP8 in Run 4 and Beyond Thanks: Presented at XXVI Cracow Epiphany Conference.
arxiv-2004-06413.creator: Maciej Trzebiński
arxiv-2004-06413.description: Abstract Proton trajectories along LHC beam 1 (clockwise direction) in the vicinity of the LHCb Interaction Point (IP8) for the most recent LHC Run 4 optics (HLLHC1.5) were presented. On this basis, three possible locations of forward proton detectors were identified: 150, 180 and 430 m from IP8. For these locations geometric acceptances were estimated.

arxiv-2204-06767.title: Learning Task-Aware Energy Disaggregation: a Federated Approach
arxiv-2204-06767.creator: Ruohong Liu, Yize Chen
arxiv-2204-06767.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Ruohong Liu, Yize Chen. We consider the problem of learning the energy disaggregation signals for residential load data. Such a task is referred as non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), and in order to find individual devices’ power consumption profiles based on aggregated meter measurements, a machine learning model is usually trained based on large amount of training data coming from a number of residential homes.

arxiv-2211-11602.title: Improving Multimodal Interactive Agents with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback
arxiv-2211-11602.creator: Interactive Agents Team
arxiv-2211-11602.description: Abstract An important goal in artificial intelligence is to create agents that can both interact naturally with humans and learn from their feedback. Here we demonstrate how to use reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to improve upon simulated, embodied agents trained to a base level of competency with imitation learning.

arxiv-2212-10509.title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
arxiv-2212-10509.creator: Harsh Trivedi † Niranjan Balasubramanian †, Tushar Khot ‡ Ashish Sabharwal ‡
arxiv-2212-10509.description: Abstract Prompting-based large language models (LLMs) are surprisingly powerful at generating natural language reasoning steps or Chains-of-Thoughts (CoT) for multi-step question answering (QA). They struggle, however, when the necessary knowledge is either unavailable to the LLM or not up-to-date within its parameters.

arxiv-2407-08953.title: Attribution Methods in Asset Pricing: Do They Account for Risk?
arxiv-2407-08953.creator: Dangxing Chen 1, Yuan Gao
arxiv-2407-08953.description: Abstract Over the past few decades, machine learning models have been extremely successful. As a result of axiomatic attribution methods, feature contributions have been explained more clearly and rigorously. There are, however, few studies that have examined domain knowledge in conjunction with the axioms. In this study, we examine asset pricing in finance, a field closely related to risk management.

arxiv-2409-18590.title: Accessibility Issues in Ad-Driven Web Applications
arxiv-2409-18590.creator: Abdul Haddi Amjad, Muhammad Danish, Bless Jah, Muhammad Ali Gulzar
arxiv-2409-18590.description: Abstract Website accessibility is essential for inclusiveness and regulatory compliance. Although third-party advertisements (ads) are a vital revenue source for free web services, they introduce significant accessibility challenges. Leasing a website’s space to ad-serving technologies like DoubleClick results in developers losing control over ad content accessibility.

arxiv-2411-08127.title: TIPO: Text to Image with Text Presampling for Prompt Optimization
arxiv-2411-08127.creator: Shih-Ying Yeh, Yi Li, Sang-Hyun Park, Giyeong Oh, Xuehai Wang, Min Song, Youngjae Yu †, Shang-Hong Lai
arxiv-2411-08127.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Shih-Ying Yeh, Yi Li, Sang-Hyun Park, Giyeong Oh, Xuehai Wang, Min Song, Youngjae Yu †, Shang-Hong Lai. TIPO (Text-to-Image Prompt Optimization) introduces an efficient approach for automatic prompt refinement in text-to-image (T2I) generation. Starting from simple user prompts, TIPO leverages a lightweight pre-trained model to expand these prompts into richer, detailed versions. Conceptually, TIPO samples refined prompts from a targeted sub-distribution within the broader semantic space, preserving the original intent while significantly improving visual quality, coherence, and detail.

arxiv-2503-03719.title: Positivity of generalized cluster scattering diagrams
arxiv-2503-03719.creator: Amanda Burcroff, Kyungyong Lee, Lang Mou
arxiv-2503-03719.description: Abstract . We introduce a new class of combinatorial objects, named tight gradings , which are certain nonnegative integer-valued functions on maximal Dyck paths. Using tight gradings, we derive a manifestly positive formula for any wall-function in a rank-2 generalized cluster scattering diagram.

arxiv-2508-15401.title: Clay Edges Are Dynamic Proton-conducting Networks Modulated by Structure and pH
arxiv-2508-15401.creator: Yixuan Feng, Xavier R. Advincula, Hongwei Fang, Christoph Schran
arxiv-2508-15401.description: Abstract Montmorillonite, a ubiquitous clay mineral, plays a vital role in geochemical and environmental processes due to its chemically complex edge surfaces. However, the molecular-scale acid–base reactivity of these interfaces remains poorly understood due to the limitations of both experimental resolution and conventional simulations.

pmc-10735854.title: DEMAND-ABILITIES FIT AND PRESTIGE INFLUENCE OLDER WORKERS’ INTEREST IN ALTERNATIVE JOBS
pmc-10735854.creator: Nathan Baker, Jenna Van Fossen, Amy Schuster, Chu-Hsiang Chang, J Kevin Ford
pmc-10735854.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). With the increasing displacement of workers due to technological innovations, many older workers may need or want to make career transitions. Therefore, it is critical to understand the factors that influence older workers acceptance of potential alternative careers. In this study, long-distance truck drivers (n=202), a profession at-risk of technological disruption, completed an online survey where they rated six alternative transition occupations (e.g., machine setting, operator and tender, cargo and freight agent) to understand what makes them interested in alternate jobs.

pmc-11614596.title: Joint association of METS-IR and uric acid with stoke, mediated by C-reactive protein
pmc-11614596.creator: Shan Jiang, Xinyi Zhang, Chengning Song, Guangfu Wu, Aicheng Yang
pmc-11614596.description: ObjectivesTo explore the dose-response relationship between the Metabolic Score of Insulin Resistance (METS-IR), uric acid (UA) and the risk of stroke incidence, the mediating role of C-reactive protein (CRP) in the above relationship, as well as the joint effect of METS-IR and UA on the risk of stroke incidence.MethodsParticipants from the CHARLS study were included in this cohort study.

pmc-11716690.title: Different functional structures of the brainstem according to dementia subtypes
pmc-11716690.creator: Kim Seul Gi
pmc-11716690.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe extent of neurofibrillary changes, one of the pathological hallmarks of AD, correlates with the severity of AD in dementia. The brainstem is known to be the site of neurofibrillary changes in the early stages of Alzhimer’s disease. The neurotransmitter system in the brainstem processes information from subcortical and cortical circuits affect to various cognitive and behavioral responses in the cerebral cortex.

pmc-12638867.title: Influence of the modification with polymer microspheres on the structural, mechanical and post-processing properties of extruded thin-walled LDPE films
pmc-12638867.creator: Aneta Tor-Świątek, Anna Jakimińska
pmc-12638867.description: This work describes the production in blown film extrusion process and characterization of the thin-walled LDPE films modified with polymer microspheres as the blowing agent. Mechanical properties of the films are investigated with the emphasis on the post-processing (welding process) as the most common for films and crucial for the applications in packaging industry.

pmc-13073663.title: VPS34 in Autophagy, Cancer, and Cancer Therapy
pmc-13073663.creator: Elisabetta Bartolini, Bassam Janji, Ruize Gao
pmc-13073663.description: Highlights What are the main findings? VPS34, the only class-III PI3K, is a central regulator of autophagy that controls autophagosome formation, cellular stress adaptation, and membrane trafficking through PI3P generation.Emerging evidence indicates that VPS34 also regulates tumor immunity and the tumor microenvironment by modulating pathways such as cGAS–STING and STAT1, thereby influencing immune cell infiltration and tumor immunogenicity.

pmc-13311833.title: A novel therapeutic strategy for Mycoplasma synoviae infection: Elucidating the synergistic effects and underlying mechanisms of Tilmicosin and Sinomenine
pmc-13311833.creator: Baoyi Deng, Xueyan Wang, Ming Li, Weihuo Li, Yangshuo Li, Jing Chang, Yu Wang, Zhongjia Yu, Nan Zhang
pmc-13311833.description: Mycoplasma synoviae (MS) is an important poultry pathogen that causes multisystem pathological damage, particularly infectious synovitis, resulting in significant economic losses to the poultry industry. Tilmicosin (TMS) is a first-line antimicrobial for mycoplasma infections; however, its limited penetration into joint tissues of MS-infected chickens compromises clinical efficacy.

pmc-13508587.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of Artificial Intelligence Models for Detecting Odontogenic Keratocytes on CBCT Imaging: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-13508587.creator: Reyhaneh Shoorgashti, Simin Lesan, Sarah Sadat Ehsani, Asma Yazdanfar
pmc-13508587.description: Background and AimsDifferentiating odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) from other radiolucent jaw lesions like ameloblastoma is clinically important but radiographically difficult. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI) show promise for enhancing diagnosis using cone‐beam computed tomography (CBCT). This study aims to systematically evaluate and meta‐analyze the diagnostic accuracy of AI models in detecting OKCs on CBCT imaging.
